_doc: One source for the face: read by face.html (injected by the server) and face/render.py. open: eye height x, w: eye width x, tilt: eye rotation (rad), curve: mouth curve (+ smile, - frown), mw: mouth width x, look: gaze offset [x, y] in eye units; flags: arc (happy eyes), dots (thinking), o (open mouth), ring (listening), zzz (sleeping), brows (sad).
